nodes.title: Place Switch Array
nodes.code_string:
# Node: Place switches along a wall (robust)
# Entradas esperadas (mismo orden):
# 0 Wall (ObjectIn: Name/Label o el objeto)
# 1 Switch template (ObjectIn: Name/Label o el objeto)
# 2 Spacing mm (Number) | 3 Height mm (Number)
# 4 Edge Offset mm (Number) | 5 Face Offset mm (Number)
# 6 Wall Side text (Left/Right/Front/Back o español)
# 7 Tag prefix (Text) | 8 Group label (Text)

import math
import FreeCAD as App
from FreeCAD import Vector

def log(msg): App.Console.PrintMessage(f"[SWITCH-ARRAY] {msg}\n")
def warn(msg): App.Console.PrintWarning(f"[SWITCH-ARRAY][WARN] {msg}\n")
def err(msg): App.Console.PrintError(f"[SWITCH-ARRAY][ERROR] {msg}\n")

def _extract(entries, index, default=None):
    if index >= len(entries): return default
    v = entries[index]
    if isinstance(v, list): return v[0] if v else default
    return v if v is not None else default

def _vec(vec):
    v = Vector(vec); return Vector(float(v.x), float(v.y), float(v.z))

def _normalized(vec):
    v = _vec(vec); L = v.Length
    return Vector(1,0,0) if L==0 else Vector(v.x/L, v.y/L, v.z/L)

def _scaled(vec, s):
    v = _vec(vec); return Vector(v.x*s, v.y*s, v.z*s)

def _translate(vec, dirv, d):
    return _vec(vec) + _scaled(dirv, d)

def _resolve_to_obj(doc, maybe_obj):
    """Acepta objeto directo, Name, o Label y devuelve el objeto o None."""
    if maybe_obj is None: return None
    # Si ya es objeto FreeCAD con Shape/TypeId, lo devolvemos
    if hasattr(maybe_obj, "TypeId") or hasattr(maybe_obj, "Shape"):
        return maybe_obj
    # Si es string, probar Name y luego Label
    if isinstance(maybe_obj, str):
        name = maybe_obj.strip()
        # 1) Name exacto
        o = doc.getObject(name)
        if o: return o
        # 2) Label exacto
        for obj in doc.Objects:
            if getattr(obj, "Label", "") == name:
                return obj
        # 3) Label “empieza con” (por si puso Wall001 pero el Name es distinto)
        for obj in doc.Objects:
            if getattr(obj, "Label", "").startswith(name):
                return obj
    return None

try:
    input_data = In if isinstance(In, list) else [In]

    wall_in   = _extract(input_data, 0, None)
    sw_in     = _extract(input_data, 1, None)
    spacing   = float(_extract(input_data, 2, 1200) or 1200)
    height    = float(_extract(input_data, 3, 1100) or 1100)
    off_edge  = float(_extract(input_data, 4, 50) or 50)
    off_face  = float(_extract(input_data, 5, 0) or 0)
    side_txt  = str(_extract(input_data, 6, "Left") or "Left").strip().lower()
    tag_pref  = str(_extract(input_data, 7, "Apagador") or "Apagador")
    group_lbl = str(_extract(input_data, 8, "Apagadores") or "Apagadores")

    doc = App.ActiveDocument
    if doc is None:
        err("No hay documento activo."); Out = []; raise SystemExit

    # Resolver objetos
    wall_obj = None
    if isinstance(wall_in, list) and wall_in: wall_in = wall_in[0]
    if isinstance(sw_in, list) and sw_in:     sw_in   = sw_in[0]

    wall_obj = _resolve_to_obj(doc, wall_in)
    sw_obj   = _resolve_to_obj(doc, sw_in)

    if wall_obj is None:
        err("No se pudo resolver el muro (por Name/Label). Revise 'Wall In'."); Out=[]
        raise SystemExit
    if sw_obj is None:
        err("No se pudo resolver el template (por Name/Label). Revise 'Switch Template'."); Out=[]
        raise SystemExit

    if not hasattr(wall_obj, "Shape") or wall_obj.Shape is None:
        err("El muro no tiene Shape válido."); Out=[]; raise SystemExit

    shape = wall_obj.Shape

    # Caras verticales
    vertical_faces = []
    for face in shape.Faces:
        try:
            n = face.normalAt(0.5, 0.5)
        except Exception:
            continue
        if abs(n.z) <= 0.4:  # normal ~ horizontal => cara ~ vertical
            vertical_faces.append((face, n, face.CenterOfMass))
    if not vertical_faces:
        err("El muro no tiene caras verticales detectables."); Out=[]; raise SystemExit

    # Lado: soportar español/inglés
    s = side_txt
    if s.startswith(("r","der")):     chosen = max(vertical_faces, key=lambda it: it[2].y)  # Right/Derecha
    elif s.startswith(("f","fr")):    chosen = max(vertical_faces, key=lambda it: it[2].x)  # Front/Frente
    elif s.startswith(("b","atr")):   chosen = min(vertical_faces, key=lambda it: it[2].x)  # Back/Atrás
    else:                             chosen = min(vertical_faces, key=lambda it: it[2].y)  # Left/Izquierda

    face, face_n, face_c = chosen
    face_n = _normalized(face_n)

    # Aristas horizontales en la cara (z ~ constante)
    horizontal_edges = []
    for e in face.Edges:
        vs = [v.Point for v in e.Vertexes]
        if len(vs) < 2: continue
        dirv = vs[-1] - vs[0]
        if dirv.Length == 0: continue
        if abs(dirv.z) > 0.1: continue  # evitar aristas inclinadas/verticales
        avgz = sum(p.z for p in vs)/len(vs)
        horizontal_edges.append((e, avgz))
    if not horizontal_edges:
        err("La cara elegida no tiene aristas horizontales."); Out=[]; raise SystemExit

    # Mejor usar la arista horizontal más larga como base
    base_edge = max(horizontal_edges, key=lambda item: item[0].Length)[0]
    edge_length = float(base_edge.Length)

    # Parámetros saneados
    spacing  = max(1.0, float(spacing))
    off_edge = max(0.0, float(off_edge))
    off_face = max(0.0, float(off_face))
    height   = max(0.0, float(height))

    if edge_length <= max(1.0, off_edge):
        err(f"Arista demasiado corta ({edge_length:.1f} mm) para el offset inicial ({off_edge:.1f} mm)."); Out=[]
        raise SystemExit

    # Muestreo del borde
    sample_step  = max(5.0, min(50.0, spacing/5.0))
    sample_count = max(10, int(edge_length / sample_step) + 2)
    samples = base_edge.discretize(sample_count)

    # Distancias acumuladas
    dists = [0.0]
    for i in range(1, len(samples)):
        dists.append(dists[-1] + samples[i-1].distanceToPoint(samples[i]))

    def point_at(d):
        if d <= 0: return Vector(samples[0])
        if d >= dists[-1]: return Vector(samples[-1])
        for i in range(1, len(samples)):
            d0, d1 = dists[i-1], dists[i]
            if d <= d1:
                t = 0.0 if d1==d0 else (d - d0)/(d1 - d0)
                p0, p1 = Vector(samples[i-1]), Vector(samples[i])
                return p0 + (p1 - p0)*t
        return Vector(samples[-1])

    def tangent_at(d):
        delta = max(10.0, spacing*0.1)
        p0 = point_at(max(0.0, d - delta))
        p1 = point_at(min(edge_length, d + delta))
        t = p1 - p0
        L = t.Length
        return Vector(1,0,0) if L==0 else t.multiply(1.0/L)

    min_face_z = min(v.Point.z for v in face.Vertexes)

    # Puntos de colocación
    current = off_edge
    placements = []
    while current <= edge_length + 0.1:
        pt = point_at(current)
        pt.z = min_face_z + height
        pt = _translate(pt, face_n, off_face)
        tg = tangent_at(current)
        placements.append((pt, tg))
        current += spacing

    log(f"Muro: {getattr(wall_obj,'Name','?')} | Cara vertical OK | Arista base L={edge_length:.1f} mm")
    log(f"Instancias a crear: {len(placements)} | spacing={spacing} off_edge={off_edge} off_face={off_face} height={height}")

    # Grupo
    grp = doc.getObject(group_lbl)
    if grp is None:
        grp = doc.addObject("App::DocumentObjectGroup", group_lbl)

    # Borrar solo los previos del prefijo (si existen)
    prev = [c for c in list(grp.Group) if getattr(c, "TypeId","")=='App::Link' and c.Label.startswith(tag_pref)]
    for lk in prev:
        grp.removeObject(lk)
        doc.removeObject(lk.Name)

    created = []
    for i,(base_pt, tg) in enumerate(placements, start=1):
        link_name = f"{tag_pref}_{i:02d}"
        link = doc.addObject("App::Link", link_name)
        link.LinkedObject = sw_obj

        x_axis = _normalized(tg)
        y_axis = _normalized(face_n)
        z_axis = x_axis.cross(y_axis)
        if z_axis.Length == 0:
            z_axis = Vector(0,0,1)
        else:
            z_axis = _normalized(z_axis)
        y_axis = _normalized(z_axis.cross(x_axis))

        m = App.Matrix()
        m.A11, m.A12, m.A13 = x_axis.x, y_axis.x, z_axis.x
        m.A21, m.A22, m.A23 = x_axis.y, y_axis.y, z_axis.y
        m.A31, m.A32, m.A33 = x_axis.z, y_axis.z, z_axis.z
        rot = App.Rotation(m)
        link.Placement = App.Placement(base_pt, rot)

        grp.addObject(link)
        created.append(link)

    doc.recompute()
    log(f"Creado(s) {len(created)} link(s) con prefijo '{tag_pref}' en grupo '{group_lbl}'.")
    Out = [created]

except SystemExit:
    pass
except Exception as ex:
    err(f"Excepción no controlada: {ex}")
    Out = []
